text:
The response is accurate throughout. It correctly gives the sample size, school count, year level, the 1.8 vs 1.1 mark improvements, the non-significant 0.7 difference, the 71% survey figure, and the caveats. It stays under 120 words (about 116). The main gap is that it never states outright that the 10% overseas effect was not found, and it doesn't clearly say schools should not expect a noticeable effect on results. The "not higher marks" line conveys this only partly. The bottom line and caveats are otherwise well chosen for a busy manager.

Score: 8
